usageNotes: Call this before creating or editing a notification matcher to discover which metadata field names are valid for match conditions (e.g. 'type', 'severity', 'hostname'). Requires Mapping.Modify or Mapping.Audit on /mapping/notifications. Takes no parameters and returns the full list of supported fields cluster-wide.

examples.summary: List all available notification matcher field names

tips: Use the returned field names as the 'field' value when constructing matcher rules via create_cluster_notifications_matcher or update_cluster_notifications_matcher.
The response only contains field names, not their allowed values — use get_cluster_notifications_matcher_field_values to enumerate valid values for a specific field.
